# Youssef Benzarti

## Book

***The Tax Mirage***. Under contract, Princeton University Press. A general-reader book on tax
incidence: who actually bears American taxes, and why the political debate gets it wrong.

## Working papers

**Moral Hazard and Adverse Selection in the Social Insurance Market for Entrepreneurs.**
With Jarkko Harju, Ella Mattinen, Tuomas Matikka and Alisa Tazhitdinova. July 2026.
[PDF](social-insurance-entrepreneurs.pdf)

**Policy Thresholds as Growth Barriers: Theory and Evidence from a Payroll Tax Notch.**
With Sami Jysmä and Jarkko Harju. NBER Working Paper 35484, July 2026.
[PDF](policy-thresholds-growth-barriers.pdf)

**Can VAT Cuts and Anti-Profiteering Measures Dampen the Effects of Food Price Inflation?**
With Santiago Garriga and Dario Tortarolo. Second revise and resubmit, *American Economic
Review*.
NBER Working Paper 32241, June 2024.
[PDF](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/mkoyp344ymtfw5fk6k1nd/VAT_price_controls_v10.pdf?rlkey=sqjf0qky28e34x18kl2h2fk7o&raw=1)

**Modern US Workers' Compensation and Work-Related Injury: No Evidence of Moral Hazard.**
With Emiliano Huet-Vaughn. NBER Working Paper 28187, November 2020.
[PDF](https://www.dropbox.com/s/qp3ictyzj6uid65/WorkersComp%20_v2.pdf?raw=1)
